parameters.content:
## Get Market Quotes (sub-workflow)
Primary source: Yahoo Finance. Backup: Alpha Vantage (indices via SPY/QQQ/DIA funds).
Retries twice, then falls back. After 3 failed runs in a row the primary is skipped for 30 min (circuit breaker).
Source health lives in Supabase Postgres (mr_source_health); if the database is unreachable, prices are still fetched.
/simulate can switch a source off on purpose for the demo.

parameters.query: select source, consecutive_failures, last_status, last_checked, simulate_down from mr_source_health order by source

insert into mr_source_health (source, consecutive_failures, last_status, last_checked) values ($1, $2::int, $3, $4::timestamptz) on conflict (source) do update set consecutive_failures = excluded.consecutive_failures, last_status = excluded.last_status, last_checked = excluded.last_checked
